summary: All 3 iter-19 concerns validated. BACKEND (9/9 pytest, /app/backend/tests/test_pronounce_and_regression.py): (1) NEW POST /api/pronounce-score returns proper {score:int 0-100, tip:non-empty str} for French ('Bonjour, je m'appelle Marie', app_locale=en) AND for Korean romanization (language=ko). Empty text returns 400 as required. (2) TTS regression — POST /api/tts {voice:'nova', speed:1.25} returns non-empty audio_base64 (>500B); voice omitted also 200 (server defaults via lang_voice). (3) Whisper transcribe fallback — synthesized English audio via /api/tts then POST /api/transcribe {mime_type:'audio/mpeg', language:'en'} returned real transcribed text on the first try (no Deepgram key configured, so Whisper path exercised). (4) Admin regression — /api/admin/login (chingunadi/0644782611) issues token, GET /api/admin/settings with Bearer -> 200 {deepgram_stt_model:'nova-2', ...}, POST /api/admin/settings {key:'deepgram_stt_model', value:'nova-2'} -> 200 {ok:true}, GET without token -> 401. FRONTEND (mobile 390x900, /voice-screen): mounts cleanly (mascot + voice-status-text 'Tap Chingu to start the live chat'); no redbox. Header PressableScale icons voice-open-voice-settings and voice-swap-langs both visible and tappable. Tapping voice-open-voice-settings opens voice-picker-card modal containing ALL 6 voice testIDs (voice-option-nova/shimmer/alloy/echo/onyx/coral) and ALL 4 speed testIDs (voice-speed-0.75/1/1.25/1.5). Selecting Shimmer + 1.25× shows active state (bg rgb(139,92,246)); tapping voice-picker-done closes the sheet; reopening the picker shows Shimmer + 1.25× still highlighted — per-language persistence via prefs store verified. Note: the native iOS/Android audio-session speaker-routing fix and the score PILL after a real spoken turn cannot be exercised on web preview (no mic, native routing differs). Backend /api/pronounce-score itself returns valid pill data, so the pill will render once the mic pipeline runs on device.

issues: On a 390x844 (iPhone SE) viewport the voice-picker-card + Done button extend just below the visible area — Playwright reported 'Element is outside of the viewport' when clicking voice-option-shimmer with a real click; JS click worked. On a real device with safe-area bottom insets this may push Done partially under the home indicator. Consider wrapping the picker contents in a ScrollView or reducing paddingTop on modalCard. Reference: /app/frontend/app/voice-screen.tsx:820-824

react_native_issues.issue: voice-screen.tsx still imports 'expo-file-system/legacy'. Works on current SDK but the legacy subpath is scheduled for removal — plan a migration to the new expo-file-system File/Directory API. Reference: /app/frontend/app/voice-screen.tsx:19

action_items: No blockers. Optional: on ≤844px viewports the voice picker's Done button sits at the very bottom edge — wrap chip groups in a ScrollView OR shorten modalCard paddingTop/paddingBottom so it fits comfortably above the safe-area bottom inset.
Optional (unchanged from iter-18): migrate voice-screen.tsx off 'expo-file-system/legacy' before the subpath is removed in a future Expo SDK.
Web console warnings persist (non-blocking, unchanged from iter-18): 'Font.loadAsync patch failed', 'useNativeDriver not supported on web', 'shadow* deprecated → boxShadow'.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: /api/pronounce-score is a strict allowlist path — empty text properly rejected with 400, JSON output is parsed with a defensive fallback (default score=75, tip default) so a malformed LLM reply cannot 500 the endpoint.
Good: pronounce-score reuses stream_llm_text + LlmChat with a per-request session_id, so it does not pollute the /api/chat session history.

Good: voice-screen.tsx calls AudioModule.setAudioModeAsync({allowsRecording:false, playsInSilentMode:true, shouldPlayInBackground:false, shouldRouteThroughEarpiece:false}) BOTH right after receiving TTS (in stop(), lines 366-371) AND again in the playback effect (lines 160-165), plus sets player.volume=1.0 (line 171) — this is the correct belt-and-suspenders fix for the iOS earpiece routing bug.

Good: PressableScale is a clean reusable spring-press wrapper (friction:6, tension:220, scaleTo:0.95) used consistently on the voice-screen header icons and the picker Done button. It skips haptics on web and cleans up on unmount via Animated.spring.
Minor: voice-screen picker modal is fixed-height and not wrapped in a ScrollView — on small phones (SE / 5.4") the Done button can be pushed under the safe-area bottom inset.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (voice-screen mount, picker open/close/persistence, PressableScale icons all working)
